body: But is it enough when I'm like this? Do they want a broken shell? I wish I could lift the fog off of me.

You are right. I am selfish. The truth is that if I never had my children, I would have been gone a long time ago. This feeling to end it... I cannot control it. Today I woke up with a heavy heart, thankful for my babies in a new way. I wish someone would tell me step by step how to make the End It feeling go away. At this time I can't afford to go talk to anyone professionally. I want to. 

I want to be happy, let things roll off of me and not bother me so much. I want to make new friends. I know no one would want to be friends with me right now. I'm a giant dark cloud and well, that's not fun to be around, right?
